# kbcli v0.4.1

**Release date:** 2026-11-24 · **Previous release:** [v0.4.0](https://github.com/ProjAnvil/kbcli/releases/tag/v0.4.0) · **License:** MIT · **Go:** 1.27.4

This patch release productizes the retrieval profiles and corrects the offline
archive. Runtime profiles become capability tiers: `lite`, `pro` and `custom`.
A fresh install starts on `lite`, which downloads nothing. The full archive now
bundles the multilingual weights that `pro` needs, so `pro` works with zero
network access.

> **Heads up:** an existing `config.yaml` without a `profile` key still loads
> as `custom`. Run `kbcli config set profile pro` and `kbcli reindex` to move
> an existing installation to the full-feature tier.

See the [full diff](https://github.com/ProjAnvil/kbcli/compare/v0.4.0...v0.4.1)
and [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ProjAnvil/kbcli/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
for the complete entry.

---

## Highlights

- **Product tiers.** `lite` replaces `local`, and `pro` replaces `multilingual`.
  The names describe capability, not implementation. `pro` also improves
  same-language conceptual recall.
- **`lite` by default.** A fresh install uses the hash embedder, disables
  reranking and downloads no model.
- **Aliases keep old configs working.** `local` and `multilingual` resolve to
  `lite` and `pro` in config files, workspace overrides and `kbcli config set`.
  kbcli writes the canonical name on the next save.
- **Full archive finally ships the right model.** It now contains both
  `intfloat/multilingual-e5-small` and the legacy aikit cross-encoder. kbcli
  detects the bundled rembed cache next to the executable and points
  `REMBED_CACHE` at it.
- **Pinned and verified.** The release build fetches both model sets in one
  step and checks all files against `assets/model.sha256`.
- **Documented default.** Both READMEs now state the tier names, the default,
  the upgrade path and the corrected settings catalog counts.

---

## What's Changed

### Added

- Offline `pro` weights at `model/rembed/intfloat--multilingual-e5-small/`
  inside every full archive.
- `configureRembedCache` in `internal/embed/rembed.go`. It detects a complete
  bundled model tree next to the executable and sets `REMBED_CACHE` to the
  bundle root. rembed then skips every download.
- Profile alias canonicalization through `canonicalProfile()`. Config files,
  workspace overrides and the CLI accept the v0.4.0 names.
- Tests for tier enforcement, alias migration, legacy config preservation,
  offline bundle detection and incomplete bundle rejection.

### Changed

- `profile` accepts `lite`, `pro` and `custom`. `canonicalProfile()` is the
  single normalization point.
- Fresh installs default to `lite`. `RerankEnabled` starts as false.
- `release.yml` downloads both model sets in one checksum-verified step and
  stages them into five per-platform full archives.
- `assets/model.sha256` now lists six pinned e5 files alongside the five
  cross-encoder files.
- Both READMEs document the new tiers, the corrected archive layout and the
  settings catalog of 52 fields in 8 groups.
- `RAG系统编程.md` chapter 12 now uses the product tier names.

### Fixed

- The full archive shipped the wrong model. It previously contained only the
  English-only aikit cross-encoder, which no productized tier uses by default.
  It omitted the multilingual weights that `pro` requires, so air-gapped `pro`
  installs failed.
- Stale README statements. The settings catalog count and the "reranking is
  on by default" claim did not match the settings redesign and the new default.

### Tests

- `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...` and `go test -race -count=1 ./...` pass.
- The CI model download step ran locally. All 11 files matched their checksums.
- The bundled model loaded with `REMBED_CACHE` and `HF_HOME` unset. The version
  was `rembed:intfloat/multilingual-e5-small#v2`, the width was 384, and the
  cross-language query/document cosine was 0.8263.

---

## Breaking Changes

- A fresh install now defaults to `lite`. It has no reranking. An install that
  needs the full stack must set `profile: pro`.
- The `profile` value names changed. kbcli accepts the v0.4.0 names as
  aliases, so existing configuration files keep working. A config file with
  no `profile` key loads as `custom` and keeps its previous rerank settings.

No index format changed. A `.kbvec` built by v0.4.0 stays valid.

---

## Upgrade Guide

1. **Install v0.4.1** (see [Installation](#installation)).
2. **Keep your current stack:** do nothing. A config without a `profile` key
   loads as `custom`.
3. **Move to the full-feature tier:**

   ```sh
   kbcli config set profile pro
   kbcli reindex
   ```

4. **Move to the lightweight tier:**

   ```sh
   kbcli config set profile lite
   kbcli reindex
   ```

5. **Use a full archive offline:** extract it and run the binary from the
   extracted directory. kbcli finds both model trees automatically. Set
   `REMBED_CACHE` to override the bundled path.
6. **Check the active tier:**

   ```sh
   kbcli config get profile
   kbcli config get embedder
   kbcli config get rerank_type
   ```

Switching between `lite` and `pro` changes the embedding domain. Run
`kbcli reindex` once after the switch. Query-time knobs need no rebuild.

---

## Installation

### From source

```sh
go install github.com/ProjAnvil/kbcli/cmd/kbcli@v0.4.1
# or
go install github.com/ProjAnvil/kbcli/cmd/kbcli@latest
```

Requires Go 1.27.4 or newer. `make install` also works from a checkout.

### Prebuilt binaries

| Tier | Asset name | Contents |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Normal | `kbcli-v0.4.1-<os>-<arch>` | Binary only. `lite` needs no model. |
| Full | `kbcli-full-v0.4.1-<os>-<arch>.tar.gz` | Binary plus both offline model trees. |

Platforms: `darwin-amd64`, `darwin-arm64`, `linux-amd64`, `linux-arm64`,
`windows-amd64`. The Windows full archive uses `.zip`.

The full archive contains:

```
kbcli
model/
  rembed/intfloat--multilingual-e5-small/
  ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2/
```

Verify a download with the uploaded `checksums.txt`:

```sh
sha256sum -c checksums.txt --ignore-missing
# macOS: shasum -a 256 -c checksums.txt --ignore-missing
```

---

## Verify

```sh
kbcli version                       # v0.4.1
kbcli config get profile            # lite on a fresh install, custom on upgrade
kbcli config get rerank_enabled     # false on lite
kbcli config get embedder           # local on lite, rembed on pro
kbcli config keys | grep '^'        # 52 fields in 8 groups
```

Verify an offline `pro` install from a full archive:

```sh
kbcli config set profile pro
kbcli index ./docs
kbcli ask "what is system design" --json --dir ./docs
```

Expected diagnostics with a Chinese corpus:

```json
{
  "profile": "pro",
  "query_language": "en",
  "kb_language": "zh",
  "translation_applied": true,
  "search_query": "什么是系统设计",
  "degraded": false
}
```

---

## Known Issues

- The `pro` weights are about 450 MB. A full archive is substantially larger
  than the normal binary. CI downloads the model once and copies the same
  files into each of the five per-platform archives. Release assets therefore
  carry five copies of the weights.
- `custom` + `aikit` still downloads the English-only cross-encoder on first
  use unless the full archive is used. It is not the recommended tier for
  multilingual corpora.
- `embed.Dim` stays fixed at 384. Models with 768 or 1024 dimensions are not
  usable yet.
- `local_maxsim` needs an embedder with token-vector support. The `lite` hash
  embedder does not provide it.
- `kbcli eval` is a self-retrieval smoke test, not a question-answer benchmark.
- Retrieval uses an exact brute-force scan with a full sort. An ANN index and
  vector quantization are not implemented.
- Windows runtime behaviour has not been verified on real hardware.
